title: Do not let grief turn into ownership
summary: Let quiet trust loosen the hand before it grips again. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: let grief answer to Hukam instead of ownership.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: The soul is not owned, and grief must answer to Hukam.
source.lifeApplication: In the first rise of panic, release the word mine and breathe beneath Hukam.
